title: The Empire Helicopter Tour of New York (25-30 Minutes)
description: See the Big Apple’s most iconic landmarks and building up close on this popular helicopter tour of New York City, while taking off and landing out of Manhattan Heliport. This is a one-of-kind pilot narrated modern and historical tour.

reviews.usertext: Excellent experience, totally recommended. Very kind crew and the trip was amazing. We will come back with no doubts.
Fantastic views. Interesting and informative commentary from the pilot. A superb experience. Very good communication from the company and quick, professional service.

From the booking process to the communications prior to flight day and the fantastic staff throughout (security, check-in, briefing, airfield, pilot), Charm Aviation/Liberty Helicopters treated me to an exhilarating and incredible experience - one of the best souvenirs I will ever keep from a trip!
The pilot was terrific, loved hearing his commentary whilst taking in the spectacular views and absorbing all the details that can be seen from above.
There was a last-minute scheduling conflict due to delays that meant the initial flight I was going to be in couldn't take place, but they rapidly rebooked me on a new date with great flexibility and offered a very rewarding compensation - customer service was outstanding!
Don't miss this chance if you get it, it was my first time on a helicopter, and I absolutely loved it. Highly recommend flying with Charm Aviation/Liberty Helicopters!
